pages.title: Carry the Weapon
pages.text: Advancement brings a sequence of lightning strikes. While the trial weapon is held, its holder takes the lightning and must survive the full sequence.$(br2)The weapon's own power and tier determine the trial strength. Prepare health, defenses, and recovery before beginning.

pages.title: Unheld Weapons
pages.text: When the weapon is not held, lightning wears down its durability directly. Keeping it in an ordinary inventory slot does not count as holding it.$(br2)Zero durability shatters the weapon and fails advancement. Wear remains; picking up a trial weapon does not cancel the remaining strikes.

pages.title: Death During the Trial
pages.text: If its holder dies during the trial, the weapon forcibly drops even with keepInventory enabled. Remaining lightning continues against the dropped weapon.$(br2)Advancement succeeds only when the weapon survives the complete sequence.
